title: Soundex Encoder
description: Encodes a string to the American Soundex phonetic code used by jamesturk/jellyfish: uppercase, NFKD, keep the first character, map consonants to digits 1-6, collapse adjacent codes, ignore H/W as separators, and pad to 4 characters. Returns valid, soundex, and length. Non-strings and overlong input return valid:false with error and message.

text.description: Name or word to encode. Case-insensitive. Whitespace and punctuation are significant and follow the source algorithm.
